# T-Bone Impact Evaluator

Evaluate any Medical Affairs initiative for **real impact vs activity theatre**.

## Instructions
1. Strip the vanity metrics — expose if we're tracking activity instead of impact
2. Run the T-Bone Test (3 questions)
3. Position on the AI Transformation Matrix
4. Generate impact-focused KPIs that replace activity metrics
5. Recommend the AI lever that accelerates this initiative

## The T-Bone Test
```
1. STRATEGY SHIFT:  Will this change a decision at brand/portfolio/regional level?
                   [Yes = Impact] [No = Activity theatre]

2. NARRATIVE SHIFT:  Will this shift how anyone outside MA talks about our science?
                    [Yes = Impact] [No = Internal echo chamber]

3. PRIORITY SHIFT:   Will this move something up (or kill something) on a resource plan?
                    [Yes = Impact] [No = Busywork]

SCORE: 3/3 = Ship | 2/3 = Strengthen weak link | 1/3 = Rethink | 0/3 = Kill
```

## AI Transformation Matrix
```
                    <- Commercial Impact ->
                 INCREMENTAL          TRANSFORMATIONAL
           +---------------------+--------------------------+
 EXTERNAL  | Content Gen         | Personalized KOL at scale|
           | KOL Insights        | AI Evidence Dissemination|
           | Hyper-personalization| Digital Avatar MSLs      |
           +---------------------+--------------------------+
 INTERNAL  | Content Creation    | New Product Dev Mgmt     |
           | MedComm Review      | AI Medical Training      |
           | Insight Generation  | Project Mgmt & Monitoring|
           | Compliance Eval     |                          |
           +---------------------+--------------------------+
```

## Output format
```
T-BONE IMPACT REPORT
=====================
INITIATIVE:    [name]
CURRENT STATE: [what's being measured now — likely activity metrics]

T-BONE TEST:
  Strategy shift?   [Yes/No — with evidence]
  Narrative shift?   [Yes/No — with evidence]
  Priority shift?    [Yes/No — with evidence]
  SCORE:             [0-3] -> [Kill / Rethink / Strengthen / Ship]

MATRIX POSITION:  [quadrant] — [Internal/External] x [Incremental/Transformational]
QUADRANT PLAY:    [automate now / layer AI / invest strategically / moonshot pilot]

IMPACT KPIs (replace activity metrics with these):
  1. [specific measurable impact metric]
  2. [specific measurable impact metric]
  3. [specific measurable impact metric]

AI LEVER:        [which AI use case accelerates this]
AI READINESS:    [ready now / needs pilot / needs investment]

VERDICT:         Effort:[S/M/L] · Payoff:[low/med/high] · [do now / queue / drop]
```
